subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
keywords: Utilizing online data and AI analysis
educationalGoal:
Establish a career as an engineer and set goals for continuing studies and finding a job.
Explore the methods that suit each student.
advice:
The course consists of the following:
(1) Career design
(2) Self-analysis
(3) Corporate research using Online Data and Communication
(4) Regional cooperation and Company visit (as possible)

All students are highly recommended to attend this course regardless of study continuation plans.
